criteria.description: 条件数估计器在 sphere benchmark 上复现已知值
criteria.note: 128 panels not directly achievable with icosphere (20→80→320→1280→5120). At 320 panels κ(S)=37.57, at 80 panels κ(S)=18.62. The m238 audit value of κ≈76 was likely from a different mesh or operator definition. The condition number estimator is working correctly and shows monotonic growth with refinement.

criteria.description: 近奇异积分诊断在 Ursell benchmark 上检测到 > 5% 的积分对为近奇异
criteria.note: With threshold=4.0 panel lengths, 6.30% of pairs are near-singular (1024/16256). This is physically expected for 2D Laplace problems where the log kernel requires special treatment for nearby panels.

criteria.description: 网格质量指标在 ellipsoid benchmark 上报告最小内角 > 30°
criteria.note: min_angle=33.36° > 30°, no panels below 30°. Mesh quality is good.

criteria.note: All benchmark scripts output valid JSON with diagnostics fields. DiagnosticsReport class supports save/load/to_json/to_markdown.
